import random, time, itertools, math
n=26

def random_cubic(n, tries=100000):
    stubs=[]
    for i in range(n): stubs += [i]*3
    for t in range(tries):
        random.shuffle(stubs)
        edges=set(); ok=True
        for a,b in zip(stubs[0::2], stubs[1::2]):
            if a==b: ok=False; break
            if a>b: a,b=b,a
            if (a,b) in edges: ok=False; break
            edges.add((a,b))
        if not ok: continue
        # check girth up to 6
        adj=[set() for _ in range(n)]
        for a,b in edges:
            adj[a].add(b); adj[b].add(a)
        # BFS from each vertex for cycle short
        g=999
        for s in range(n):
            dist=[-1]*n; par=[-1]*n
            dist[s]=0; q=[s]
            for v in q:
                if dist[v]>=3: continue # for cycle <=6 via edge between depth <=3? need enough
                for w in adj[v]:
                    if dist[w]<0:
                        dist[w]=dist[v]+1; par[w]=v; q.append(w)
                    elif par[v]!=w and par[w]!=v:
                        g=min(g, dist[v]+dist[w]+1)
                        if g<7: break
                if g<7: break
            if g<7: break
        if g>=7:
            return t, sorted(edges)
    return None
start=time.time()
res=random_cubic(n, 2000000)
print('time', time.time()-start, 'res', res[0] if res else None)
if res:
    print(res[1])
    print(len(res[1]))
